products.name: Udio
products.note: AI music generation; copyright risk; likeness in vocals; RIAA litigation context

profile_text.body:
Udio is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company operates an AI music generation platform at udio.com, which it describes as a tool that lets users discover, create, and share music using what the site calls "the latest technology to create AI music in seconds."

The site's held facts categorize Udio's core product under Voice and Audio, noting copyright risk, likeness in vocals, and an RIAA litigation context. Udio is a defendant in UMG Recordings v. Uncharted Labs, Inc. (Udio), filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, a case that reflects broader industry disputes over the use of recorded music in training AI generation systems.
